query: WITH touch AS (UPDATE sessions SET last_seen_at = $2, user_agent = coalesce($3, user_agent) WHERE token_hash = $1 AND expires_at > $2 AND (last_seen_at IS NULL OR last_seen_at < $2 - interval '1 minute')) SELECT users.profile AS "profile!: Json<Profile>", sessions.public_id AS "public_id!" FROM sessions JOIN users ON users.id = sessions.user_id WHERE token_hash = $1 AND expires_at > $2
